title: Human-in-the-Loop Check-in Copilot
summary: Turns free-text weekly check-ins into structured, evidence-backed decisions — with a human approving every risky route.
problem: Keyword rules misread real messages, but handing routing to an LLM alone is unsafe for sensitive text.
solution: A 23-node n8n workflow: webhook → guardrails (PII redaction, prompt-injection blocking) → local LLM extraction into schema-validated JSON with verbatim evidence → deterministic routing rules → human approval through a paused Wait node → audit trail.
result: On realistic messages keyword rules alone misrouted 5 of 8 — the case for LLM extraction, with deterministic rules keeping the final decision. Runs on a local model, so sensitive text never leaves the machine.
highlights: Tested end to end on six scenarios
Every extracted field must quote the message verbatim
Approval pause and full execution history as the audit log
